One of the [[Unidentified planetoid (Vesla system)|planets]] of the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] was the home of a species of nocturnal '''predators'''. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], they suffered from the presence of [[Darth Mekhis]]' [[Sun Razer]] in orbit of the star, as it affected the climate of their planet, making it colder.

During their [[Mission to the Vesla system|mission]] to spy on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] killed two specimens as they were trying to attack them during the night.
